fields.title: Audit-Ready Subcontractor & Diversity Compliance Pipeline.
fields.subtitle: EVOConnect gives prime contractors, estimators, and compliance executives instant access to a searchable directory of pre-profiled, SAM-aligned, and socioeconomic-certified subcontractors built for government contract execution.

fields.heading: Engineered for Primes Operating on Compressed Bid Timelines
fields.intro: Federal and state solicitations mandate strict DBE/HUB/8(a) participation goals and verified trade capacity. EVOConnect delivers an actionable subcontractor pipeline searchable in seconds.

cards.title: Multi-Parameter Vendor Search
cards.body: Filter small businesses by six-digit NAICS code, trade specialization, SAM.gov registration status, bonding capacity, and mobilization radius.

cards.title: Set-Aside & Good-Faith Tracking
cards.body: Isolate DBE, MBE, WBE, Texas HUB, SDVOSB, and SBA 8(a) subcontractors immediately to meet statutory participation goals and document outreach.

cards.title: Targeted RFQ Broadcasting
cards.body: Publish Request for Qualifications (RFQs) directly to NAICS-matched small-business subcontractors in your project corridor and review bids in one console.

cards.title: Verified Capability & Contact Access
cards.body: Inspect standardized capability statements, initiate direct connection requests, and export vetted subcontractor rosters for bid packages.

fields.heading: Transparent Prime Licensing
fields.intro: Flexible monthly access scaled to your estimating volume and compliance requirements.

cards.title: Basic — $49/month
cards.body: For regional primes initiating structured subcontractor outreach. Includes Business & Labor Directory access, up to 10 connection requests/month, and SAM.gov UEI filtering.

cards.title: Pro — $149/month (Most Popular)
cards.body: For active primes assembling certified sub pipelines across multiple bids. Includes unlimited vendor connections, full DBE/MBE/HUB/8(a)/SDVOSB filtering, 6-digit NAICS search, and CSV export.

cards.title: Enterprise — $399/month
cards.body: For national primes and GCs managing major government infrastructure portfolios. Includes unlimited RFQ broadcasting, multi-seat team access, dedicated account executive, and good-faith reporting.

fields.heading: Ready to Mobilize Your Certified Subcontractor Pipeline?
fields.text: Join EVOConnect and start sourcing qualified, SAM-aligned, and diversity-certified subcontractors today.
